definition: deepset is an enterprise software vendor that provides developers with the tools to build production-ready Artificial Intelligence (AI) and natural language processing (NLP) systems, using architectures such as agents, retrieval augmented generation (RAG) and multimodal AI.
details: It was founded in 2018 in Berlin by Milos Rusic, Malte Pietsch, and Timo Möller. deepset authored and maintains the open source software Haystack and its commercial SaaS and self-hosted (VPC, on-prem, air gapped) offering, Haystack Enterprise Platform. (formerly known as deepset Cloud and deepset AI Platform)

explainer.lead: Deepset is a Berlin-founded enterprise software company that helps developers build AI and natural language processing systems. Its work centers on the open-source Haystack software and a commercial platform for deploying that technology.

tiers.eli5: Deepset is like a toolbox maker for people building computer programs that work with language. Its main toolbox is called Haystack, and it also offers a paid version for organizations that want extra hosting choices.
tiers.practitioner: Developers can use deepset's open-source Haystack software to build systems involving agents, retrieval augmented generation, or multimodal AI. Haystack Enterprise Platform is the commercial option, available as SaaS or self-hosted in a VPC, on-premises, or in an air-gapped environment.
tiers.paperLevel: Deepset is an organization rather than a formal algorithm, so no mathematical definition or formula applies. Its stated technical scope includes agents, retrieval augmented generation, and multimodal AI for production-oriented AI and NLP systems.

explainer.example: A developer could use Haystack to build a retrieval augmented generation system, then use Haystack Enterprise Platform to run it as a hosted service or within the organization's own environment.
